verdict.rationale: The pack never documents a Gemini admin console for managing members, permissions, or organization data policies. The only related mentions say an administrator can enable Gemini for work or school accounts. That control belongs to the host Google Workspace platform, not to Gemini itself, so it earns no credit. The no-human-review statement about chats is a fixed data-handling commitment, not an admin-configurable policy.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can manage members, permissions, and data policies for my organization's workspace
